errors.iata_requires_bind: The IATA code changes only through Meshloom Community settings (bind or join), never with a plain settings update.
errors.join_requires_bind: Join Meshloom Community from its settings: the IATA code is bound first, then Community is turned on.
errors.community_banned: This radio has been banned from Meshloom Community. If you think this is a mistake, write to ban@meshloom.app.
errors.radio_no_response_after_send: Send command was issued to the radio, but no response was heard back. The message may or may not have sent successfully.
errors.radio_inconsistency_found: A periodic poll task has discovered radio inconsistencies.
errors.opt_out_other_radio: Connect the radio that left Community, then retry.
errors.no_pending_opt_out: There is no opt-out to send again.
errors.opt_out_key_unknown: The radio that left Community is not known, so the deletion cannot be sent again from here. Write to privacy@meshloom.app.
errors.ble_pair_wrong_pinDetail: Check the PIN shown on the radio, save it, then press Pair again in Settings > Radio.
errors.ble_pair_rejectedDetail: If the radio was reset or paired with another machine, press Forget pairing, then Pair again.
errors.ble_pair_invalid_pin: The Bluetooth PIN must be 1 to 6 digits
errors.ble_pair_device_blocked: The radio is blocked in this machine’s Bluetooth settings
errors.ble_pair_unreachable: The radio did not answer over Bluetooth
errors.ble_pair_in_progress: A Bluetooth pairing is already in progress
errors.ble_pair_stale_bond: The radio refuses this machine’s saved pairing
errors.ble_pair_stale_bondDetail: If it was reset or re-flashed, press Forget pairing in Settings > Radio.
errors.ble_pair_dbus_unavailable: The system Bluetooth service cannot be reached
errors.ble_pair_dbus_unavailableDetail: In Docker, map the host’s /run/dbus/system_bus_socket into the container. In Home Assistant, update the add-on.
errors.ble_pair_bluez_unavailable: The Bluetooth service (bluetoothd) is not running
errors.ble_pair_permission_denied: Meshloom is not allowed to pair through the Bluetooth service
errors.ble_pair_adapter_off: The Bluetooth adapter is turned off
errors.ble_pair_adapter_blockedDetail: Unblock it with `rfkill unblock bluetooth` or the system settings.
errors.ble_pair_unsupported: Automatic Bluetooth pairing is not available on this system
errors.ble_pair_not_configured: Save a Bluetooth address and PIN first
errors.radio_busy: The radio is busy with another operation. Try again in a moment.
